correctness.rationale: Exactly derived B² and B³ identities, reduced all matrix powers to two polynomial blocks, determined smallest mod-two order by nonzero matrix witnesses, and computed valuations modulo four/eight with explicit polynomials and witness entries. value.rationale: A natural two-population graph family receives a complete and exact all-moduli finite-torus period classification, with four arithmetic symmetry classes plus an exceptional single-edge graph. The sharp transition between even-part residue classes modulo four is nontrivial and can guide studies of finite-state symplectic lattice dynamics; no downstream general theorem is required to make these exact invariants mathematically meaningful.
